name: Stone_Golem
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing from non-magical weapons
condition_immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
languages: Understands languages of its creator but does not speak
notes: CR 10. AC 17. HP 120. Multiattack: 2 Slam attacks. Slam +10 (3d8+6 bludgeoning). Slow (Recharge 5-6): DC 17 Con save or speed halved and can only attack OR move (not both) for 1 min. Immunities: Adamantine, poison, psychic, non-magical B/P/S. Immutable Form: immune to any spell/effect that alters form. Magic Resistance: adv on saves vs spells.
gm_notes: Session 3 Sacred Grove — NOT killable enemies at L5. Avatars of Mars' anger manifesting through standing stones. Used for Option A defensive hold. Party goal: hold them off for 4 ritual successes (Option B skill challenge). Golems fade automatically when ritual completes. Cover positions (Survival DC 11 before ritual) displace each golem 1 round. Each ritual failure adds +1 golem. Do NOT run as combat-to-win.
